title: Counterfactual Neighborhood Risk Fields: Evidence-Grounded Selective Safety for Vision-Language Models
authors: Tianshi Wang, Jingsong Wang, Fengling Li, Jingjing Li, Xin Li, Lei Zhu

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.20679）：CNRF 把 VLM representation-based safety 的'只做 representation separation 不知道 risk score 含义 / 不知道什么时候可信赖'拉到'CNRF：context-matched benign-harmful counterfactual pair + 用 representation difference 作为 capability-related risk direction + neighborhood evidence + selective safety'。是 security-governance × multimodal-agent 的 'counterfactual risk field VLM safety' 趋势资产——'counterfactual risk field for selective VLM safety' 范式可迁移到任何 'evidence-grounded safety / counterfactual risk modeling / multimodal safety governance' 子方向（VLM guardrail、safety eval、risk score calibration），与 aiutil 长期关注的 security-governance × multimodal-agent 主线在 'counterfactual safety' 层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无（仅 PDF / arXiv），需打开 PDF 看 counterfactual 构造方式、risk field 形式化（locally linear / kernel-based）、跨 VLM 验证。今日新趋势卡片：维持 7-30 天滚动观察周期。
